	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/notification"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/store"
)

const maxAPIRequestBytes = 256 << 20

type APIV1Service struct {
	v1pb.UnimplementedInstanceServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAttachmentServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAIServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedIdentityProviderServiceServer

	Secret                  string
	Profile                 *profile.Profile
	Store                   *store.Store
	MarkdownService         markdown.Service
	SSEHub                  *SSEHub
	NotificationEmailSender notification.EmailSender

	// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion
	thumbnailSemaphore       *semaphore.Weighted
	imageProcessingSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted

	// instanceStatsCache memoizes GetInstanceStats results for instanceStatsCacheTTL.
	instanceStatsCache instanceStatsCache
}

func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
	return &APIV1Service{
		Secret:                   secret,
		Profile:                  profile,
		Store:                    store,

}

content.text: Let me check whether the web side also has a markdown interface with multiple implementations, to make sure I answer about the right one.

h13.

**Answer: `*markdown.service` (the only impl) — constructed by `markdown.NewService(...)` in `NewAPIV1Service` (plus test helpers) — held by `APIV1Service`, `rss.RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`.**

## The interface

`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` — `markdown.Service`, an 8-method contract: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`.

## Concrete implementation — exactly one

`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` — the unexported `type service struct { md goldmark.Markdown }`. It is the sole implementation; all eight methods hang off `*service` (`markdown.go:143, 193, 244, 255, 264, 349, 356, 425`), and there are no mocks, fakes, or alternate implementations anywhere in the tree — tests use the real one.

Behavioral variation comes from functional options rather than from swapping types: `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` (`markdown.go:71, 78`) toggle the custom goldmark extenders in `internal/markdown/extensions/{tag,mention}.go`; GFM is always on.

## Construction

- **Production, the only runtime construction:** `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` inside `NewAPIV1Service`, with *both* options enabled. That's reached from `server/server.go:76`.
- **Test-only:** `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44` (both options), `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427` (tags only), `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54` (no options).

Note the production instance is created once and shared — `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService` rather than building a second one.

## Holders of the interface type

Three struct fields plus one function parameter:
